verdict.rationale: Pylon's docs describe several natural-language interfaces. The Assist Agent can be messaged to investigate, draft replies and perform actions. Ask AI is a chat for asking about your data, and the Slack Agent takes quick actions from Slack. The official MCP server also lets Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor read and update issues, accounts and contacts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed docs on which actions natural-language commands can perform (Ask AI appears to be query-only).
